name: DEPUSDT/LEVUSDC approveToken missing access control
summary: DEPUSDT and LEVUSDC inherit CurveSwap.approveToken, a public function that approves any token held by the contract to any spender. The attacker had each proxy approve its USDT or USDC to the attack contract and pulled the balances with transferFrom.
notes: LEVUSDC (0x2a2b1955, LevErc20 behind its own proxy) carries the identical CurveSwap.approveToken and was drained by the same attack contract six blocks later: one campaign against sibling deployments (rule 4), not a separate incident.
Copycat approveToken calls (0xfdc86382, 0x949354e0) found nothing left to pull.
